paragraphs: Aventiv Technologies is the holding company for a set of businesses that sell communications, monitoring and payment technology to correctional facilities and supervision agencies. Securus Technologies covers calling and related services for incarcerated people and their families, alongside security tools for the facility.

That same business supplies education, job training and other reentry resources inside facilities. A second unit, Securus Monitoring, sells electronic monitoring for government agencies, correctional facilities and parole and probation officers. JPay handles the money side, letting families move funds into a trust account while giving the facility an automated system to run and watch.

The company states that its monitoring arm has more than 900 partnerships across North America. It also describes in-kind support for nonprofits working on recidivism and reentry, and work with corrections leaders to widen access to education and job training.
